headline.purpose: Every section heading, the hero motto quote, and the closing lines in the hall.

title.purpose: Plan names, feature rows, card titles.

lead.purpose: The line under a headline, in Fog.

label.purpose: Small print, categories, currency labels, in Ash.

till.purpose: Every price and total, tabular, rolled digit by digit.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Every border: cards, fields, secondary buttons, segmented tracks, modals.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Placed objects: screenshots, the sticky hardware total, modals.

shadows.name: phone-drop
shadows.purpose: Transparent device-framed phone images (filter, not box-shadow); 0 16px 24px in the gallery.

shadows.name: segment-selected

shadows.name: highlight-ring
shadows.purpose: State: Premium plan and picked hardware.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 22%, transparent)

narrative.overview:
The landing page borrows the Tashkent Metro at night. The navigation is a line map: the sections are stops on one green line and the current stop fills. The ground is tunnel ink (dark is the default) and type is marble white. The proverb "Hisobli do'st ayrilmas" rides in the hero as a badge, and the closing is a glazed cobalt tile hall with its grout grid. Light mode is the same station by day: platform marble ground, dark ink type, a deeper green line.

Density is calm and editorial: generous section padding, one accent, hairlines instead of borders, flat surfaces. Proof is the product itself: real desktop till and report screenshots on white, real phone screenshots in their device frames, real hardware photos on white canvases. Headlines and stop names speak in station signage (Unbounded 500); everything you read is Onest; money is printed in till digits that roll to their value.

The build replaced an earlier warm-neutral look. It refuses the category's stacked hero plus rows of equal feature cards: sections are ruled rows and boards, not tiles. (An earlier version of this build ran a green rail with stop roundels down the left of every section; the owner removed it, along with the proverb's tile hall, on 2026-11-20.)
keyCharacteristics: One green line, one accent: the nav line map, primary buttons and selection states all use the same green.
Tunnel ink ground by default, platform marble in light mode, every token switched with `light-dark()`.
One cobalt tile hall (64px tiles, 2px grout), for the closing statement only.
Station signage type for headlines, the motto and nav stop names only; Onest for reading; till digits for every price and total.
Flat surfaces with inset hairlines; the only real shadows lift screenshots and floating totals off the page.
Motion is CSS-only and scroll-driven where possible: the mobile call bar rises after the hero.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Green is the line. If an element is green, it is on the line, it is the action, or it marks the current or chosen thing. No second accent color exists.

rules.name: The One Hall Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears only as a full-bleed tile hall, and the page has one: the closing. A second hall dilutes the pause.

rules.name: The Switch-Once Rule
rules.body: A theme color is declared once with `light-dark()` on `:root`; components never branch on the theme.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Unbounded is for headlines, the hero motto, nav stop names and the mobile line-map menu (22px). Never for body text, buttons or labels.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Weights are 400 and 500. Size and color carry hierarchy, not bold.

rules.name: The Till Rule
rules.body: A number that is money is set in Till Digits with tabular figures, and when it changes it rolls digit by digit rather than snapping.

rules.name: The Whole Tile Rule
rules.body: Inside a cobalt hall, spacing is counted in 64px tiles. Content never starts mid-tile.

rules.name: The Flat Platform Rule
rules.body: If it is part of the page, it is flat with a hairline. If it is a thing placed on the page (a screen, a phone, a total, a dialog), it may float.

dos: **Do** declare any new theme color once on `:root` with `light-dark()`, and check contrast in both modes against the values in the Colors section.
**Do** set every price and total in Till Digits, and roll changing amounts with the Number Roll.
**Do** put product screenshots and hardware photos on Screen White with a 12px radius, hairline and Float.
**Do** draw borders as 1px inset hairlines (`var(--line)`) and keep surfaces flat at rest.
**Do** count hall spacing in whole 64px tiles.
**Do** prefer platform features for motion and state: scroll-driven animations, `@starting-style`, native `<dialog>` and `<details>`.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second accent color; green is the line and the action.
**Don't** use cobalt outside the closing tile hall, or add a second hall.
**Don't** set body text, buttons or labels in Unbounded, or use weights above 500.
**Don't** add drop shadows to page-level cards or sections; only placed objects (screens, phones, totals, dialogs) float.
**Don't** use circles for anything but the nav line map's stops.
**Don't** add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings, or a rail down the side of the page; the heading carries the section.
**Don't** build a CSS device frame around phone screenshots; the screenshots arrive framed.
**Don't** add a theme editor or palette controls; the only theme control is the light/dark toggle, dark by default.
